# Scotland Business Guide
> Independent directory of free Scottish business support, grants, accelerators, mentors, student enterprise programmes, women's networks, and Asian business chambers across Scotland.
> Official domain: https://scotlandbusinessguide.com/
> Contact: hello@scotlandbusinessguide.com
